name: monitor
description: Portable logging + reporting workflow. Maintains a project-local monitor/ folder (Dashboard + Reports + Logs) backed by a canonical operations.mtr (schema locked in code) and a report template that evolves additively from profile.json. Logs and Reports are paginated statically (10 per page, plain Prev/Next links, no JS/server). Every page shows the current git branch, and each log entry and report records the branch its change was made on. Logs by default after every operation and reports by default before every merge, capturing decisions, rationale, architecture impact, next steps, and gaps so a new agent can resume cold; the policy is mirrored to persistent memory at init. Report design/theme is locked to a canonical palette independent of content-tone requests (audience, reading level, language) and force-corrected on authoring via --lock-report. Commands: /monitor:init, /monitor:log, /monitor:report, /monitor:record, /monitor:update, /monitor:clean-logs, /monitor:clean-reports. Engine is stdlib-only Python 3 with graceful fallbacks for optional companion skills.
